title: Per-chain context overrides
description: Optional. A strategy's chain.context selects the vendored ipor-abi snapshot contexts/ipor-abi/mainnet-<context>.json, which supplies every IPOR contract address (deploy/context.py). This file holds only what cannot be derived from ipor-abi or the FuseWhitelist.

chain_id.description: Only for tools run without a strategy, when the context name is not in deploy/context.py CHAIN_IDS.

ipor_abi_deployment.description: Only when the ipor-abi folder is not mainnet-<context name>.

public_rpc.description: Read-only public endpoint for dry-runs when RPC_URL is unset; never used for --broadcast.

contracts.description: Override a root contract's ipor-abi key (fusion_factory, price_oracle_middleware, fuse_whitelist, middleware_owner, morpho_blue) when this chain differs from the defaults.

standard_fuses.description: Override the factory-injected fuses (ipor-abi keys, oldest first) when this chain differs from BurnRequestFeeFuse, BurnRequestFeeFuseV2.

aliases.description: A name strategies use -> the ipor-abi key it means, when they differ on this chain.

pins.description: A fuse or pre-hook pinned to one address over the registries. Re-validated on every run: a pinned fuse must still be active on the FuseWhitelist.

external_addresses.description: Third-party contracts ipor-abi does not list (e.g. the Aave V3 pool), with where the address comes from.

markets.description: Market name -> id, only for ids the SDK's IporFusionMarkets does not know.

tokens.description: Token symbol -> address (third-party ERC20s) for names a strategy uses; the address report checks symbol() on-chain.
